INSTRUCTIONS TO USE THESE PORTRAITS IN THE GAME: 
1. Download Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard. [Chose either the Config Edition or the Event Edition. I recommend the Event Edition.]
2. Add the one you chose to your Mods folder. [Usually located in Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > Mods]
3. Open the Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard folder, then the [CP] Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard folder, assets folder, and Portraits folder.
4. Replace the 53 png images in this Portraits folder with the png images you downloaded from my mod.
5. The game should work exactly as described in Jellonip's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard mod page. (Except the Wizard is now a catboy.)
